models_evaluated: HIT computerized risk (HIT-CR) score CDS advisory

links.outcome: Clinician response (diagnostic testing) to CDS advisory in highest-risk patients
links.effect: 14 of 26 patients with 4Ts scores ≥6 did not undergo HIT diagnostic testing despite the advisory; eight had possible complications from undiagnosed HIT.
links.quote: Fourteen of the 26 patients with 4Ts scores ≥6 did not undergo diagnostic testing for HIT despite the CDS advisory, and eight had possible complications from undiagnosed HIT.

unlisted_practices: Predictive risk score-triggered CDS advisory with platelet count temporal graph and risk-assessment prompts to increase diagnostic testing

screen.reason: The study evaluates a rule-based clinical decision support score (HIT-CR/4Ts score) rather than modern artificial intelligence or machine learning.
